competitor_alerts: Simcha Kosher Catering is the top-ranked kosher caterer across multiple keywords, has been operating since 1983, and carries ~19-23 reviews at 4.3-4.4 stars on Chamber of Commerce/Birdeye.

Meat Point (kosher steakhouse) has 288+ reviews (4.1 stars) and runs an active weekly Friday Shabbat take-home menu — directly competing for the 'Shabbat meals Dallas' term where The Hungry Rooster has no visibility.

Dallas Kosher (dallaskosher.org), the local certification nonprofit, outranks nearly every individual kosher business — including The Hungry Rooster — on almost every searched keyword via its restaurant and catering directory pages. Getting a strong listing there has outsized SEO value.
No new kosher restaurant or caterer openings were found in Dallas-area food news for this period.

recommendations.action: Give /catering and /shabbat pages their own unique, keyword-rich <title> and meta description (currently both pages just inherit the homepage's title/description verbatim), and fix their canonical tags, which incorrectly point back to the homepage instead of to themselves.
recommendations.reason: Found during this audit: both pages currently look like duplicate homepage content to search engines, which is likely why 'kosher catering Dallas' and 'Shabbat meals Dallas' aren't ranking well despite having dedicated pages.

recommendations.reason: These three keywords returned zero visibility for the site, while directory sites (Yelp, Dallas Kosher, TripAdvisor) and aggregators (Uber Eats, DoorDash) occupy the entire first page.

quick_wins: Fix the /catering and /shabbat page titles, meta descriptions, and canonical tags — a same-day dev fix that currently makes both pages look like homepage duplicates to search engines.
Add a direct 'Leave us a Google review' link alongside the existing internal review form so reviews start counting toward the Google Business Profile.
Request/update the business listing on dallaskosher.org/restaurants and double-check name/address/phone consistency on Yelp.
summary: The Hungry Rooster has decent baseline SEO (keyword-rich homepage title/meta, clean site structure) but is invisible for 4 of 7 target keywords and barely cracking page 1 for the other 3, while Dallas Kosher's directory and established competitors like Simcha Kosher Catering and Meat Point dominate. The single biggest fix is that the /catering and /shabbat pages currently duplicate the homepage's title, meta description, and canonical tag instead of targeting their own keywords — correcting that plus building out Shabbat-specific content and more reviews should be the near-term focus.
